text:
maria (Account Exec): Quick heads-up — pilot launch with Pulsar Analytics tomorrow 10am PT. Need staging access plan: hosted API keys for devs, a small Dedicated pool for load testing, and VPC peering for their security team. Who can own gating + handoff?

elaine (Sales Engineer): I can drive the keys + Dedicated request. For VPC peering we need infra sign-off. Quick checklist I propose: 1) ephemeral hosted API keys for engineers 2) Dedicated pool (1xA100 equiv, 2 instances, eu-west-1 fallback) 3) VPC peering + route table + security group allow list 4) send security questionnaire answers.

omar (Solutions Eng): +1. For the Hosted keys, use short-lived keys and limit to staging origin. Example create via CLI:```bash
redwood keys create --env staging --name pulsar-dev --expires 72h --scopes generation,embeddings
```
Then share via 1Password shared note.

infra-oncall: For peering we need their AWS account ID + VPC CIDR and target subnet. We only allow peering on Private plan customers; confirm they signed the NDA (they have). Also ask their network team to add an allowlist for 10.2.0.0/16 (our staging nat) or we can use a bastion.

elaine (Sales Engineer): Draft of answers to security questionnaire snippets they asked: - Data retention: default 30 days for KV/cache, customer-controlled logs retention on Dedicated. - KMS: we support customer-managed keys (Bring Your Own KMS) on Private; Dedicated can integrate with KMS via our provisioning flow. - SOC2: we can share summary + redacted report via NDA. I'll attach docs after call.

maria (Account Exec): Pricing check — they asked for an estimate: approx cost for the small Dedicated pool + baseline hosted usage for 2-week pilot. 

omar (Solutions Eng): Rough estimate: Dedicated pool (2x A100-equivalent) reserved for 2 weeks = ~ $9k-$12k (depends on committed hours/discount). Hosted dev API usage (100k tokens gen + 100k embed) ~ $20-$50. Call that ~ $10.5k mid. Mark as not final; ops will finalize.

deploy-bot: deploy:staging 1782104575 - Dedicated pool request created (req-5942) by elaine. Status: pending-infra-approval.

infra-oncall: I'll approve as long as they provide VPC CIDR + security contact. ETA 2 hours. Also note: for peering we need to create a route in their VPC to route 10.2.0.0/16 -> peering-conn-xxxx.

elaine (Sales Engineer): Owner assignments: Keys/credentials = me, Dedicated provisioning = me (req-5942), VPC peering coordination = infra-oncall. Maria, please confirm the security contact and their preferred window for peering (we need maintenance window 11pm-3am UTC or a one-off exception).

maria (Account Exec): Confirmed security contact: julian.network@pulsar.ai. Preferred window: tomorrow 23:00 UTC. I'll send invite and attach questionnaire answers. Anything else blocker-wise?

omar (Solutions Eng): One more note — for load tests we should pre-warm cache and set batching to 64 tokens to get realistic latency. I'll produce a short runbook snippet for the load script. Example curl for hosted staging:```bash
curl https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"model":"rwd-large","prompt":"Hello"}'
```
I'll drop the load script in the shared folder now.

elaine (Sales Engineer): Great. I'll update the internal onboarding checklist: - create ephemeral keys + share in 1Password - submit Dedicated req (req-5942) - collect AWS account ID + VPC CIDR + security contact - schedule peering window - send SSQ answers + SOC2 summary - confirm pricing estimate and sign PO. I'll post the checklist link after creating the doc. :thumbsup:

maria (Account Exec): Thanks all. If infra approves within 2h we should be green for the window. I'll follow up with Pulsar ops.

infra-oncall: Approved req-5942 at 1782104588. Leaving this thread, reach out on #eng-oncall if peering hits routing issues.
